Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card is in the breeding area and would digivolve into a card with the [Mineral] or [Rock] trait?

Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a card with the [Mineral] or [Rock] trait, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
Inherited Effect: When effects trash this card from a [Mineral] or [Rock] trait Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 4 or less.
